description: List Washington State legislative bills for a BIENNIUM filtered by procedural status: "introduced" (every bill filed, default), "passed_house", "passed_senate", "passed_legislature", "signed" (by the Governor), "vetoed", or "partial_veto" (the last three require agency: "House" or "Senate", the chamber of origin). Returns aggregate counts (by chamber, by type, active count) first, then a page of bare bill records (id, type, chamber, active) — call wa_bill_status on an id for its description. Reads directly from the Washington State Legislature's own bill-tracking service. Use for "how many bills passed the Legislature in 2025-26", "what did the Governor sign from the House in 2025-26". Keyless.

agency.description: Chamber of origin, "House" or "Senate" — required for status signed/vetoed/partial_veto.

biennium.description: Washington biennium, e.g. "2025-26" or a year like "2026". Omit for the current biennium.

limit.description: Max records to return, default 15, max 50.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the full result set, default 0.

status.description: One of: introduced (default), passed_house, passed_senate, passed_legislature, signed, vetoed, partial_veto.

name: wa_session_bills
title: Wa Session Bills
